subject: Warm handoff: VividPath pilot — scope, timelines, and owners
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@vividpathhealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-03-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: VividPath pilot — high level handoff + first deliverables

Hi all,

Quick warm handoff from my side — excited that VividPath is greenlit for the 6-week pilot. Key context below so CS and Implementation can pick this up:

Deal summary
- Pilot: 6 weeks, 3k calls/day expected at peak, sandbox -> staging -> production path
- Scope: clinical triage assistant (text-only) + embedding search for internal KB
- Success criteria: 80% high-confidence triage for top 5 intents; embedding MRR >= 0.78 on the evaluation set

Important dates
- Kickoff (internal): 2028-03-19 (we proposed next Tues)
- Customer kickoff: 2028-03-22
- Pilot end / evaluation: 2028-05-03

Security & infra notes (customer asks)
- Requires VPC peering for tokenized logs (no PII in logs), SSO via Okta, and SOC2 evidence (we have that packaged)
- Network team needs the checklist attached — likely a mid-week touchpoint to sort firewall rules

Files I attached: SOW_v2.pdf (includes acceptance criteria), network_integration_checklist.xlsx, sample_prompt_set.jsonl

Proposed ownership (please accept or suggest alternate):
- Tessa Morgan: CS lead — overall success plan, weekly cadence, exec sponsor communications
- Irene Choi: Implementation/Tech PM — integration, sandbox setup, smoke tests
- Marcus Lin (me): AE — escalation, contract clarifications, coordinates procurement

Next steps I suggest:
1) Tessa/Irene: confirm owners and whether you want a pre-kickoff scoping call with their infra team (I can intro)
2) If OK, I’ll schedule the customer kickoff for 3/22 and include an agenda draft

Jordan — anything I missed that you want on the kickoff agenda?

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
m: (415) 555-0192
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@vividpathhealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-03-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VividPath pilot — high level handoff + first deliverables

Thanks Marcus — good summary. I accept ownership as CS lead. A few clarifying items from my side before we calendar the kickoff: 

Operational clarifications
- Can Jordan confirm whether the 3k calls/day is concurrent burst or aggregated daily? That impacts whether we spin up dedicated Dedicated capacity for the pilot or run on hosted with throttles.
- We’ll need a sample of the KB (anonymized) and the eval prompt set two business days before sandbox access so we can build initial embeddings and sanity checks

Security 
- We will request Okta SSO metadata and an IP allowlist. If VividPath requires HSM-based KMS, flag that now — it may shift timeline.

Communication cadence
- Suggest weekly 30-min standups (Thursdays 11am PT) and a stakeholder demo at week 3 to validate early signals

Irene — can you pick tentative dates for a 90-min integration prep call with their infra and devops? Prefer Wed/Thu next week.

Jordan — can you share the KB sample and confirm the burst detail?

Tessa Morgan | Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@vividpathhealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-03-13T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VividPath pilot — high level handoff + first deliverables

Thanks — jumping in. Quick implementation plan draft and open items: 

Immediate (this week)
- Integration prep call (90 min): propose Wed 2028-03-14 10:30am PT — agenda: network ports, VPC peering details, SSO metadata, sample data transfer method
- I’ll open a sandbox environment and request API keys; expect sandbox keys within 48h of accepted IP ranges

Configuration workstream
- Embedding pipeline: will provision CPU staging job to compute initial vectors; expect 24-48h for the sample KB (size dependent)
- Model selection: recommend starting on RWI-3.2 (quantized), fallback to RWI-3.1 if latency issues appear

Risks / blockers
- If procurement delays the signed SOW, we can still do a pre-kickoff technical onboarding, but live testing can’t begin until sandbox is active
- Customer firewall that blocks outbound connections to our telemetry endpoint — need procurement/infra to confirm

I’ll prepare a short runbook for the kickoff and drop it in the Drive link once ready.

Irene Choi | Technical Program Manager, Implementation | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@vividpathhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@vividpathhealth.com>
Date: 2028-03-14T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VividPath pilot — high level handoff + first deliverables

Appreciate the clear notes, Marcus/Tessa/Irene. Quick answers and a tweak on the timeline: 

Burst vs aggregated
- The 3k is aggregated daily with short bursts up to ~300 concurrent. We’re OK starting on hosted for the pilot assuming a soft throttle option — we’ll monitor.

KB sample & files
- Sending over an anonymized KB sample and the evaluation prompt set to your Drive link now (shared).

Procurement & SOW
- Procurement is reviewing SOW_v2; they asked whether we can confirm data residency (US-only) and a 30-day log retention window. I added Procurement on cc.

Okta & network call
- Wed 3/14 10:30am PT works for our infra. Okta metadata attached in the shared Drive folder.

Next steps from our side
- We’ll sign the SOW pending the minor residency/retention note — expect signatures by EOD Friday 3/16
- For the kickoff on 3/22, please include a brief checklist for stakeholders and a pre-read (we’ll circulate internally)

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Lee | Director, Digital Products | VividPath Health
